# Expenses policy

## What can be claimed
Travel, accommodation and meals on company business can be claimed. Personal entertainment,
fines and alcohol cannot.

## Limits
Hotel stays are capped at 180 per night in capital cities and 120 elsewhere. The daily meal
allowance is 45. Economy class is required for flights under six hours.

## Submitting a claim
Claims are submitted within 30 days of the expense, with an itemised receipt for anything over
25. The line manager approves the claim and finance reimburses it in the next payroll run.
